articles.author: Benzinga Weekend Correspondent
articles.headline: OPEC+ Agrees To Raise Output Even as Hormuz Shipping Security Remains Uncertain
articles.summary: OPEC+ members agreed to raise their collective oil‑production quotas from August even as crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz remain uncertain.
articles._summary: OPEC+ members agreed to raise their collective oil‑production quotas from August even as crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz remain uncertain. Seven nations led by Saudi Arabia and Russia will add 188,000 barrels per day to their August output target, OPEC said Sunday. Ministers from Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria and Oman approved the adjustment during virtual talks on Sunday. "The countries will continue to closely monitor and assess market conditions," OPEC said. "They reaffirmed the importance of adopting a cautious approach and retaining full flexibility to increase." The decision follows months of conflict‑driven disruption to Hormuz that pushed regional output to historic lows, forcing producers to build large inventories. The strait handles roughly a fifth of global oil flows and has remained a flashpoint between Washington and Tehran.
articles._zh_headline: 尽管霍尔木兹航运安全仍存在不确定性，OPEC+仍同意增产
articles._zh_summary: 尽管通过霍尔木兹海峡的原油运输仍存在不确定性，但 OPEC+ 成员国同意从 8 月起提高集体石油生产配额。欧佩克周日表示，以沙特阿拉伯和俄罗斯为首的七个国家将在其 8 月份产量目标的基础上增加 188,000 桶/日。沙特阿拉伯、俄罗斯、伊拉克、科威特、哈萨克斯坦、阿尔及利亚和阿曼的部长在周日的虚拟会谈中批准了这一调整。 “各国将继续密切监测和评估市场状况，”欧佩克表示。 “他们重申了采取谨慎态度并保留充分灵活性来增加的重要性。”这一决定是在霍尔木兹地区因冲突而中断数月之后做出的，该地区的产量降至历史低点，迫使生产商建立大量库存。该海峡处理着全球大约五分之一的石油流量，并且仍然是华盛顿和德黑兰之间的热点。

articles.headline: Deadly Russian Strikes Rock Kyiv on Eve of NATO Summit
articles.summary: Ballistic missiles were fired into the capital of Ukraine, as Russia launched its second major attack in less than a week. At least seven people were killed, officials said.

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: SCHD ETF Is Beating VOO and QQQ This Year Despite Limited AI Exposure
articles.summary: The SCHD ETF is doing better than S&P 500's VOO and Nasdaq 100's QQQ this year despite having a limited exposure to the AI supercycle
articles._summary: The Schwab US Dividend Equity ETF (NYSE: SCHD ) is hovering near its all-time high and is beating the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 in terms of total returns this year, a sign that there is demand for value stocks. The fund has performed well despite having limited exposure to high-growth sectors such as artificial intelligence (AI). Consumer staples is its largest sector allocation, accounting for 20% of the portfolio. It is followed by healthcare, energy, and industrials, giving the fund a more defensive sector mix.
articles._zh_headline: 尽管人工智能曝光有限，但 SCHD ETF 今年仍击败了 VOO 和 QQQ
articles._zh_summary: 施瓦布美国股息股票 ETF（纽约证券交易所股票代码：SCHD）目前徘徊在历史高点附近，今年的总回报率超过了标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克 100 指数，这表明对价值股票的需求。尽管该基金对人工智能（AI）等高增长行业的投资有限，但仍表现良好。消费必需品是其最大的配置行业，占投资组合的 20%。其次是医疗保健、能源和工业，这使得该基金的行业组合更具防御性。

articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: Samsung Eyes Another Record Quarter on Explosive AI Memory Demand, But Rising Employee Bonuses Could Cloud Earnings: Report
articles.summary: Samsung is expected to post a record profit as booming AI memory demand offsets concerns over rising bonus costs.
articles._summary: Samsung is expected to report an operating profit of about 86 trillion won ($56.35 billion) for the April-to-June quarter, according to an LSEG SmartEstimate based on forecasts from 30 analysts, Reuters reported on Sunday. That would represent an almost 18-fold increase from 4.7 trillion won a year earlier and mark the company’s third consecutive quarter of record operating profit.
articles._zh_headline: 报告称，三星的人工智能内存需求将再创新高，但员工奖金的上涨可能会影响盈利
articles._zh_summary: 据路透社周日报道，根据 LSEG SmartEstimate，基于 30 名分析师的预测，三星预计 4 月至 6 月季度的营业利润约为 86 万亿韩元（563.5 亿美元）。这将比去年同期的 4.7 万亿韩元增长近 18 倍，也标志着该公司连续第三个季度创纪录的营业利润。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: Michael Dell Reaffirms $250 Trump Accounts Pledge to 25M Children, Says It Gives Them 'A Real Stake' in America
articles.summary: Michael Dell reiterated his $6.25 billion pledge to provide $250 to 25 million children as Trump Accounts launched nationwide.
articles._summary: Michael Dell on Saturday renewed support for the Trump Accounts program as it officially launched nationwide, reiterating the $6.25 billion pledge he and his wife , Susan Dell , made last year to provide $250 to 25 million qualifying American children. The founder and CEO of Dell Technologies Inc (NYSE: DELL ) in a post on X described the pledge as a way to give the next generation a ‘real stake’ in the U.S. economy.
articles._zh_headline: 迈克尔·戴尔重申特朗普账户向 2500 万儿童提供 250 美元的承诺，称这让他们在美国获得了“真正的利益”
articles._zh_summary: 周六，迈克尔·戴尔 (Michael Dell) 再次支持特朗普账户计划，该计划在全国范围内正式启动，并重申了他和妻子苏珊·戴尔 (Susan Dell) 去年做出的 62.5 亿美元承诺，为符合条件的美国儿童提供 250 至 2500 万美元。戴尔科技公司（纽约证券交易所代码：DELL）的创始人兼首席执行官在 X 上的一篇帖子中将这一承诺描述为让下一代在美国经济中获得“真正利益”的一种方式。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: DRAM Stock Drops 25% as Its Biggest Risks Start Unfolding
articles.summary: DRAM stock price has slumped by 25% from its highest level on record, as some of its biggest risks start to unfold.
articles._summary: The Roundhill Memory ETF (CBOE: DRAM) has suffered a big pullback this month, falling by 25% from its all-time high, as key risks in the memory industry starts to unfold. DRAM, which was launched in April, is still up by 125% from its record low, with its assets under management (AUM) at $22.16 billion. It has become the fastest-growing ETF to cross the $20 billion milestone.
articles._zh_headline: 最大风险开始显现 DRAM 股价下跌 25%
articles._zh_summary: 随着内存行业的主要风险开始显现，Roundhill Memory ETF（CBOE：DRAM）本月遭遇大幅回调，较历史高点下跌 25%。 4月份推出的DRAM仍较历史低点上涨125%，其管理资产（AUM）为221.6亿美元。它已成为增长最快的 ETF，突破 200 亿美元大关。
